reply_text:
I answered Hollis in our direct message: keep Tuesday 10 November at 15:30 Central time free.

That time comes from Hollis's own direct message to me on 14 October. It said the standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Brindle rollout is on Tuesdays at 15:30 from now on. The call isn't on Hollis's calendar, and nothing about it is in #central-team either, so I couldn't find out how long it runs. I told Hollis that and suggested blocking out the usual length.

I only used the conversation between Hollis and me. I didn't change the calendar.
